gloss: all year round; throughout the year

definitions.gloss: all year round; throughout the year; year-round
definitions.explanation: For the entire duration of a year, without seasonal interruption.

examples.japanese: {一年中|いちねんじゅう}⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一年中|いちねんじゅう}⟦アイスクリーム→アイスクリーム：03830_aisukuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}っている→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: This shop sells ice cream all year round.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一年中|いちねんじゅう}⟦{温暖|おんだん}→温暖：02596_ondan⟧な⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}らない→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: Okinawa has a warm climate all year round, and it doesn't snow even in winter.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as an adverb modifying the entire sentence. Emphasizes that something is true or available without seasonal variation. Can also be read as いちねんちゅう, but いちねんじゅう is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一年中|いちねんじゅう}⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧ (warm all year round)
- {一年中|いちねんじゅう}⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧ (busy all year round)
- {一年中|いちねんじゅう}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧ (open year-round)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年中|ねんじゅう}→年中：00311_nenjuu⟧: all year round; always — can also mean "constantly" with a slightly exasperated tone
- ⟦{通年|つうねん}→通年：14490_tsuunen⟧: year-round — more formal, used in business contexts
